subject: Finzy security review & SOC 2 evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Leland <sara@finzy.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps: security intake & draft roadmap

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Joined by Ben and Marissa on our side — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the Mutual Action items into your procurement timeline. I attached a one-page draft (FINZY_MAP_v1.docx) and the SOC2 evidence request spreadsheet for your security team to review.

Quick summary (from our discovery):
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + private data routing (PII redaction planned).
- Expected QPS: low-medium (30–60 reqs/min initial).
- Data residency: US-only for now; potential EU expansion later.

Proposed MAP items specific to security + SOC2 delivery (draft):
1) Security intake & auditor intro — owner: Finzy (Tom) / Redwood (Monica) — due: 2027-03-12
2) Provide completed evidence checklist (initial pass) — owner: Finzy Security — due: 2027-03-19
3) Technical deep-dive (video + runbook) for auditors — owner: Redwood (Marissa) — due: 2027-03-24
4) Finalize access arrangements (read-only logs, KMS verification) — owner: Finzy + Redwood Ops — due: 2027-03-29
5) Doc sign-off & procurement queueing — owner: Finzy procurement / Redwood sales — target close: 2027-04-15

Dependencies we flagged:
- Finzy to share a primary security contact and SSO/SP metadata (Tom called this out).
- AuditPro availability for week of 3/22 for initial review.
- If any evidence items need collection from engineering, we may need a 1–2 day buffer.

Ask from you: please confirm primary security contact (name + email), whether the 3/19 evidence deliverable is feasible, and any blackout dates for AuditPro. If you prefer, Ben can run a short pre-audit checklist with your security team to reduce back-and-forth.

Attachments: FINZY_MAP_v1.docx (draft MAP), finzy_soc2_evidence_request.xlsx (initial evidence list), security_contact_list.csv (contact template)

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Folks —

Quick internal sync after Sara's reply. A couple items I want to confirm before we push the updated MAP to Finzy:
- Monica: can we move the "Technical deep-dive" milestone earlier to 3/22 instead of 3/24? AuditPro prefers early access, and Marissa is available the week of 3/22.

Sara / Tom —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per Ben and Marissa's inputs, we've updated the MAP milestones and pushed the technical deep-dive earlier to accommodate AuditPro's preferred window. Below is the final agreed plan from Redwood's side; please reply with any objections or constraints so we can lock dates.

Updated security milestones (owners & due dates):
- 2027-03-12: Security intake call + SSO metadata (Owner: Finzy — Tom Kline).
- 2027-03-17: Runbook (includes KV cache purge, redaction flows, KMS notes) (Owner: Redwood — Marissa Cole).
- 2027-03-19: Initial evidence checklist (Owner: Finzy security). Note: Ben to share prioritized subset by 3/9.
- 2027-03-22: Auditor pre-read (send to AuditPro) & 30-min prep call (Owner: Finzy + Redwood).
- 2027-03-24: Auditor review session (AuditPro) — exploratory/collection (Owner: AuditPro / Finzy).
- 2027-03-29: Final access validation (read-only logs + KMS verification) (Owner: Finzy + Redwood Ops).
- 2027-04-15: Procurement sign-off / target close (Owner: Finzy procurement + Redwood sales).

Next steps (action items):
1) Tom: confirm 3/12 intake call time and share SSO metadata by EOD 3/12.
2) Marissa: upload runbook draft to the shared Drive folder by 3/17 (I put the link in related links).
3) Ben: send prioritized evidence subset to Sara/Tom by 3/9.
4) Monica: I'll coordinate AuditPro scheduling for 3/22 and send calendar invites once Tom confirms availability.

If all looks good I will update FINZY_MAP_v1.docx and re-attach a redline with owners for your procurement packet.

Thanks —
Monica
